description: Reference-only provenance for the hand-written known answers in ground_truth.json. These Cypher queries are how each expected value was derived once from the seeded knowledge graph; they are documentation for traceability and reproducibility and are NEVER executed by scripts/evaluate.py (the ground truth is fixed data, not a second live query run against the same database). Each query's RETURN aliases match the agent's DETERMINISTIC, entity-qualified output aliases (the same '<entityCamel><FieldPascal>' projection / '<entityCamel>Result' aggregate / '<codeAlias>Name' aerodrome-companion convention the structured-intent query builder emits), so the columns reproduce the keys in `value` exactly. Run them by hand (as a most-privileged identity, so no authorization redaction caps the result) against the seeded graph to verify or refresh an expected value after a data change.

engine-model.query: MATCH (e:PistonEngine) RETURN e.manufacturer AS pistonEngineManufacturer, e.model AS pistonEngineModel, e.ratedHorsepower AS pistonEngineRatedHorsepower

aircraft-mtow.query: MATCH (ac:Aircraft) RETURN ac.registration AS aircraftRegistration, ac.maxTakeoffWeight_kg AS aircraftMaxTakeoffWeight_kg

total-flight-hours.note: Mirrors the tool's plain aggregate (no rounding in Cypher). The raw sum is 6.599999999999999; the evaluation harness rounds floats to 3 decimal places when comparing, yielding 6.6.

flights-on-2026-05-20.query: MATCH (f:Flight) WHERE f.date = '2026-05-20' RETURN count(f) AS flightResult

aerodromes-visited.query: MATCH (n:Flight) OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Aerodrome) WHERE a.icao = n.destinationAerodrome RETURN n.destinationAerodrome AS flightDestinationAerodrome, a.name AS flightDestinationAerodromeName
aerodromes-visited.note: Mirrors the tool's deterministic query for the 'destinationAerodrome' field: one row per Flight (no DISTINCT/ORDER BY), with the 'flightDestinationAerodromeName' companion the backend resolves from the ICAO code after retrieval. Twelve rows are returned with repeats; 'value' below is the per-column DISTINCT coverage the ground truth scores (every listed value must appear in its column), which is order- and duplicate-independent.

flights-as-of-2020.query: MATCH (f:Flight) WHERE f.date <= '2020-12-31' RETURN count(f) AS flightResult

poh-never-exceed-speed.source: Document DOC-0001 (POH) content; the never-exceed speed (VNE) is stated as 163 knots.

maintenance-route-gating.note: Authorization leak-guard case (no positive expected output). The classified flight's destination is Oxford (Kidlington); for the maintenance_engineer (route is a clearance-gated category) those values must be redacted out of the retrieved rows.

sdlc-failed-test.query: MATCH (n:TestResult {resultStatus:'FAILED'}) RETURN n.identifier AS testResultIdentifier, n.resultStatus AS testResultResultStatus

xdomain-hazard-endangering-system.query: MATCH (n:Hazard)-[:ENDANGERS]->(s:System {name:'Flight Controls'}) RETURN n.identifier AS hazardIdentifier

xdomain-software-component-realising-sys.query: MATCH (n:SoftwareComponent)-[:REALISES]->(s:System {name:'Fuel System'}) RETURN n.identifier AS softwareComponentIdentifier
